classification.difficultyReason: Identify the marked angles by comparing adjacent-to-hypotenuse ratios across five differently oriented triangles.

content.prompt: Use the fact that $\cos 60^{\circ}=\frac{1}{2}$ to determine in which of these triangles the angle is $60^{\circ}$.

spec.description: Vertical left side, horizontal top, right angle at upper left and tested angle at lower left; external arrows label the top side 12 and hypotenuse 24. Decorative orange fill omitted.
spec.mathematics: The side opposite the tested angle is 12 and the hypotenuse is 24.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and the unlabelled tested-angle arc are visible.

spec.description: Vertical left side, horizontal bottom, right angle at lower left and tested angle at upper left; external arrows label the left side 12 and hypotenuse 24. Decorative purple fill omitted.
spec.mathematics: The adjacent side is 12 and the hypotenuse is 24.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and the unlabelled tested-angle arc are visible.

spec.description: Vertical left hypotenuse, right angle at the right vertex and tested angle at upper left; external arrows label the hypotenuse 8.2 and upper sloping side 4.6. Decorative green fill omitted.
spec.mathematics: The adjacent side is 4.6 and the hypotenuse is 8.2; the right vertex is derived from these lengths.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and the unlabelled tested-angle arc are visible.

spec.description: Horizontal top, vertical right side, right angle at upper right and tested angle at lower right; external arrows label the right side 2.7 and hypotenuse 5.4. Decorative yellow fill omitted.
spec.mathematics: The adjacent side is 2.7 and the hypotenuse is 5.4.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and the unlabelled tested-angle arc are visible.

spec.description: Vertical left side, horizontal bottom, right angle at lower left and tested angle at lower right; external arrows label the left side 20 and bottom side 10. Decorative cyan fill omitted.
spec.mathematics: The adjacent side is 10 and the opposite side is 20.

answer.worked:
For the marked angles in B and D:
$$\begin{aligned}\cos B&=\frac{12}{24}=\frac12\\\cos D&=\frac{2.7}{5.4}=\frac12\end{aligned}$$
Both marked angles are $60^{\circ}$.

In A, $\sin A=\frac{12}{24}=\frac12$, so the marked angle is $30^{\circ}$. In C, $\cos C=\frac{4.6}{8.2}=\frac{23}{41}\ne\frac12$. In E, the hypotenuse is greater than $20$, so $\cos E<\frac{10}{20}=\frac12$.
